questions.question: If x 4 + y 4 = x 2 y 2 , then the value of x 6 + y 6 is:
questions.questionHtml: If x<sup>4</sup> + y<sup>4</sup> = x<sup>2</sup>y<sup>2</sup>, then the value of x<sup>6</sup> + y<sup>6</sup> is:
questions.solution:
x4 + y4 = x2y2 ⇒ x4 + y4 - x2y2 = 0 

⇒ x6 + y6 = (x2)3 + (y2)3 = ({x2} + {y2})({x4} + {y4} - {x2}{y2})

⇒ x6 + y6 = 0

questions.question: If \(a + \frac{1}{a} + 2 = 0\) , then the value of \({a^{15}} - \frac{1}{{{a^{100}}}}\) is:
questions.questionHtml: If \(a + \frac{1}{a} + 2 = 0\) , then the value of \({a^{15}} - \frac{1}{{{a^{100}}}}\) is:
questions.solution:
Given:

\(a + \frac{1}{a} + 2 = 0\)

Concept Used :

( a + b )2 = a2 + b2 + 2ab 

Calculation:​

​\(a\; + \;\frac{1}{a}\; + 2 = 0\)

⇒ a2 + 1 + 2a = 0

⇒ (a + 1)2 = 0

⇒a = - 1, -1

a15 - 1/(a100) = ( - 1)15 - 1/( - 1)100

⇒ -1 - 1

⇒ - 2

∴ the value of a15 - 1/(a100) is -2.​

questions.question: If x + y + z = 3, xy + yz + zx = -12 and xyz = -16, then the value of \(\sqrt{x^3 + y^3 + z^3 + 13} \) is:
questions.questionHtml: If x + y + z = 3, xy + yz + zx = -12 and xyz = -16, then the value of \(\sqrt{x^3 + y^3 + z^3 + 13} \) is:
questions.solution:
Given:

x + y + z = 3, xy + yz + zx = -12 and xyz = -16

Formula used:

x3 + y3 + z3 – 3xyz = (x + y + z) [(x + y + z)2 – 3(xy + yz + zx)]

Calculation:

According to the question

x3 + y3 + z3 – 3xyz = (x + y + z) [(x + y + z)2 – 3(xy + yz + zx)]

⇒ x3 + y3 + z3 – 3 (-16) = 3 [(3)2 – 3(-12)]

⇒ x3 + y3 + z3 + 48 = 3(9 + 36)

⇒ x3 + y3 + z3 + 48 = 3(45)

⇒ x3 + y3 + z3 + 48 = 135

⇒ x3 + y3 + z3 = (135 – 48)

⇒  x3 + y3 + z3 = 87

Now,

\(√{x^3 + y^3 + z^3 + 13} \) = √(87 + 13)

⇒ √100

⇒ 10

∴ The required value is 10

questions.question: If \((y - \frac{1}{y}) = 4\) , find the value of \((y^6 + \frac{1}{y^6})\) .
questions.questionHtml: If \((y - \frac{1}{y}) = 4\), find the value of \((y^6 + \frac{1}{y^6})\).
questions.solution:
y - (1/y) = 4 ⇒ y + (1/y) = √(42 + 4) = √20 ⇒ y + (1/y) = 2√5

⇒ y3 + (1/y3) = (2√5)3 - 3 × 2√5 ⇒ 40√5 - 6√5 = 34√5

⇒ y3 + (1/y3) = 34√5 ⇒ {y3 + (1/y3)}2 = (34√5)2 ⇒ y6 + (1/y6) + 2 = 1156 × 5 ⇒ y6 + (1/y6) = (5780 - 2) = 5778

questions.question: Simplify the following expression. \(\frac{5(a^6 - b^6)^3 + 5(b^6 - c^6)^3 + 5(c^6 - a^6)^3} {2(a^3 - b^3)^3 + 2(b^3- c^3)^3 + 2(c^3 - a^3)^3}\)
questions.questionHtml:
Simplify the following expression. 

\(\frac{5(a^6 - b^6)^3 + 5(b^6 - c^6)^3 + 5(c^6 - a^6)^3} {2(a^3 - b^3)^3 + 2(b^3- c^3)^3 + 2(c^3 - a^3)^3}\)
questions.solution:
Given:

\(\frac{5(a^6 - b^6)^3 + 5(b^6 - c^6)^3 + 5(c^6 - a^6)^3} {2(a^3 - b^3)^3 + 2(b^3- c^3)^3 + 2(c^3 - a^3)^3}\)

Concept used:

If a + b + c = 0 then a3 + b3 + c3 = 3abc.

a2 - b2 = (a + b) (a - b)

Calculation:

\(\frac{5(a^6 - b^6)^3 + 5(b^6 - c^6)^3 + 5(c^6 - a^6)^3} {2(a^3 - b^3)^3 + 2(b^3- c^3)^3 + 2(c^3 - a^3)^3}\)

⇒ 5/2 [ {3 × (a6 - b6) × (b6 - c6) × (c6 - a6)} / {3 × (a3 - b3) × (b3 - c3) × (c3 - a3)} ]

⇒ 5/2 [ {(a6 - b6) × (b6 - c6) × (c6 - a6)} / {(a3 - b3) × (b3 - c3) × (c3 - a3)} ]

⇒  5/2 [ {(a3 + b3) (a3 - b3) × (b3 + c3) (b3 - c3) × (c3 + a3) (c3 - a3)} / {(a3 - b3) × (b3 - c3) × (c3 - a3)} ]

⇒ 5/2 × {(a3 + b3) (b3 + c3) (c3 + a3)}

∴ The required value of \(\frac{5(a^6 - b^6)^3 + 5(b^6 - c^6)^3 + 5(c^6 - a^6)^3} {2(a^3 - b^3)^3 + 2(b^3- c^3)^3 + 2(c^3 - a^3)^3}\) is \(\frac{5}{2} (a^3 + b^3) (b^3 + c^3 ) (c^3 + a^3)\).

questions.solution: \(\frac{s^2+t^2+2 s t-u^2}{s^2-t^2-2 t u-u^2}\) ⇒ {(s + t)2 - u2}/{s2 - (t + u)2} ⇒ {(s + t)2 - u2}/{s2 - (t + u)2} ⇒ {(s + t + u) × (s + t - u)}/{(s + t + u) × (s - t - u)} ⇒ \(\frac{s+t-u}{s-t-u}\)

questions.questionHtml: If 3a = 27b = 81c and abc = 144, then the value of \(12\left( {\frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{{2b}} + \frac{1}{{5c}}} \right)\) is:
questions.solution:
3a = 27b = 81c

⇒ 3a = 33b = 34c

Comparing on powers

a = 3b = 4c

Let a = 3b = 4c = k

a = k

⇒ 3b = k

⇒ b = k/3

⇒ 4c = k

⇒ c = k/4

abc = 144

k × k/3 × k/4 = 12 × 12

k3 = 12 × 12 × 12

⇒ k = 12

a = 12

b = 12/3 = 4

c = 12/4 = 3

Now,

12 (1/a + 1/2b + 1/5c)

⇒ 12 (1/12 + 1/8 + 1/15)

⇒ 12 × (10 + 15 + 8)/120

⇒ 33/10

Shortcut Trick3a = 27b = 81c

3a = 33b = 34c

If we put a = 12, b = 4 and c = 3, then

312 = 312 = 312 [condition satisfied]

Now,

12 (1/a + 1/2b + 1/5c)

⇒ 12 (1/12 + 1/8 + 1/15)

⇒ 12 × (10 + 15 + 8)/120

⇒ 33/10

questions.question: If x 2 + y 2 = 45 and x - y = 5 then what is the value of x 3 - y 3 ?
questions.questionHtml: If x<sup>2</sup> + y<sup>2</sup> = 45 and x - y = 5 then what is the value of x<sup>3</sup> - y<sup>3</sup>?
questions.solution:
Given:

x2 + y2 = 45

x - y = 5

Formula used:

(a - b)2 = a2 + b2 - 2ab

a3 - b3 = (a - b)(a2 + b2 + ab)

Calculation:

x - y = 5

⇒ (x - y)2 = 25

⇒ x2 + y2 – 2xy = 25

⇒ 45 – 2xy = 25

⇒ 2xy =  20

⇒ xy =  10

x3 - y3 = (x - y)(x2 + y2 + xy)

⇒ 5{45 + 10}

⇒ 5 × 55

⇒ 275

∴ Required answer is 275

⇒ 900

⇒ x + y = 30

Then, x is (30 + 18) / 2 = 24 and y = 6

questions.question: If a 2 + b 2 + 49 c 2 + 18 = 2(b - 28c - a) then the value of (a + b - 7c) is:
questions.questionHtml: If a2 +  b2 + 49c2 + 18 = 2(b - 28c - a) then the value of (a + b - 7c) is:
questions.solution:
a2 +  b2 + 49c2 + 18 = 2 (b - 28c - a) ⇒ a2 +  b2 + 49c2 + 18 - 2b + 56c + 2a = 0 ⇒ a2 + 2a + 1 + b2 - 2b + 1 + 49c2 + 56c + 16 = 0 ⇒ (a + 1)2 + (b - 1)2 + (7c + 4)2 = 0

Now the above equation is 0, only when a + 1 = 0, b - 1 = 0, 7c + 4 = 0 ⇒ a = - 1, b = 1, c = - 4/7

Then, (a + b - 7c) = (- 1) + 1 - [7 × (- 4/7)] = - 1 + 1 + 4 = 4

questions.question: If x 4 + x 2 y 2 + y 4 = 21 and x 2 + xy + y 2 = 3, then what is the value of (-xy)?
questions.questionHtml: If x<sup>4 </sup>+ x<sup>2</sup>y<sup>2 </sup>+ y<sup>4</sup> = 21 and x<sup>2</sup> + xy + y<sup>2</sup> = 3, then what is the value of (-xy)?
questions.solution:
Given:

x4 + x2y2 + y4 = 21 and x2 + xy + y2 = 3

Formula used:

x4 + x2y2 + y4 = (x2 – xy + y2) (x2 + xy + y2)

Calculation:

x4 + x2y2 + y4 = 21 

And, x2 + xy + y2 = 3 ......(1)

Now,

x4 + x2y2 + y4 = (x2 – xy + y2) (x2 + xy + y2)

⇒ 21 = (x2 – xy + y2) × 3

⇒ (x2 – xy + y2) = 7 ......(2)

Subtracting equation (2) from (1) we get,

(x2 – xy + y2 = 7) – (x2 + xy + y2 = 3)

⇒ 2xy = (-4)

⇒ xy = (-4/2)

⇒ xy = -2

Now,

The value of -xy = 2

∴ The required value is 2

questions.question: if \(a + \frac{1}{a} = 7\sqrt3 \) , then what is the value of \(a^6 + a^{-6}\) ?
questions.questionHtml: if \(a + \frac{1}{a} = 7\sqrt3 \), then what is the value of \(a^6 + a^{-6}\)?
questions.solution:
\(a + \frac{1}{a} = 7\sqrt3 \)

Square both sides:

\( \Rightarrow (a + \frac{1}{a})^2 = (7\sqrt{3})^2 \) \( \Rightarrow a^2 + \frac{1}{a^2} = 145 \)

Square both sides again:

\( \Rightarrow (a^2 + \frac{1}{a^2})^2 = 145^2 \)  \( \Rightarrow a^4 + \frac{1}{a^4} = 21023 \)

Using the formula for \(a^6 + \frac{1}{a^6}\) :

\( \Rightarrow a^6 + \frac{1}{a^6} = (a^2 + \frac{1}{a^2})^3 - 3(a^2 + \frac{1}{a^2}) \)

\( \Rightarrow a^6 + \frac{1}{a^6} = 145^3 - 3 \times 145 \) = 3048190

questions.question: What is the value of \(({k - {1 \over k}})({k^2 + {1 \over k^2}})({k^4 + {1 \over k^4}})({k^8 + {1 \over k^8}})({k^{16} + {1 \over k^{16}}})({k^{32} + {1 \over k^{32}}})\) ?

What is the value of

\(({k - {1 \over k}})({k^2 + {1 \over k^2}})({k^4 + {1 \over k^4}})({k^8 + {1 \over k^8}})({k^{16} + {1 \over k^{16}}})({k^{32} + {1 \over k^{32}}})\)?
questions.solution:
\(\frac{({k - {1 \over k}})({k^2 + {1 \over k^2}})({k^4 + {1 \over k^4}})({k^8 + {1 \over k^8}})({k^{16} + {1 \over k^{16}}})({k^{32} + {1 \over k^{32}}})({k + {1 \over k}})}{({k +{1 \over k}})}\)    [By multiplying and dividing \(k +{1 \over k}\)]

⇒ \(\frac{({k^2 - {1 \over k^2}})({k^2 + {1 \over k^2}})({k^4 + {1 \over k^4}})({k^8 + {1 \over k^8}})({k^{16} + {1 \over k^{16}}})({k^{32} + {1 \over k^{32}}})}{({k +{1 \over k}})}\)

⇒ \(\frac{({k^{32} - {1 \over k^{32}}})({k^{32} + {1 \over k^{32}}})}{({k +{1 \over k}})}\) ⇒ \(\frac{{k^{64} - {1 \over k^{64}}}}{{k +{1 \over k}}}\)

questions.question: If a + b + c = 5, a 2 + b 2 + c 2 = 27, a 3 + b 3 + c 3 = 125, then the value of \(\frac{abc}{5}\) is:
questions.questionHtml: If a + b + c = 5, a2 + b2 + c2 = 27, a3 + b3 + c3 = 125, then the value of \(\frac{abc}{5}\) is:
questions.solution:
Given:

a + b + c = 5, a2 + b2 + c2 = 27 and a3 + b3 + c3 = 125

Concept used:

a2 + b2 + c2 = (a + b + c)2 - 2(ab + bc + ca)

a3 + b3 + c3 - 3abc = (a + b + c)(a2 + b2 + c2 - ab - bc - ca)

Calculation:

27 = 52 - 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ ab + bc + ca = -1

Now,

a3 + b3 + c3 - 3abc = [(a + b + c){a2 + b2 + c2 - (ab + bc + ca)}]

⇒ 125 - 3abc = (5){27 - (-1)}

⇒ 3abc = 125 - 140

⇒ 3abc = -15

⇒ abc = -5

∴ The value of abc/5 is -1

questions.question: If (a + b + c) = 20, and a 2 + b 2 + c 2 = 152, find the value of a 3 + b 3 + c 3 - 3abc.
questions.questionHtml: If (a + b + c) = 20, and a<sup>2</sup> + b<sup>2</sup> + c<sup>2</sup> = 152, find the value of a<sup>3</sup> + b<sup>3</sup> + c<sup>3 </sup>- 3abc.
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Direct formula: a3 + b3 + c3 − 3abc = 1/2 × (a + b + c) × [3(a2 + b2 + c2) − (a + b + c)2]

⇒ 1/2 × 20 × [3 × 152 − 202]

⇒ 10 × [456 − 400]

⇒ 10 × 56 = 560

∴ The correct answer is 560.

Alternate Method

Given:

(a + b + c) = 20

a2 + b2 + c2 = 152

Formula Used:

(a + b + c)2 = a2 + b2 + c2 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

a3 + b3 + c3 − 3abc = (a + b + c)[a2 + b2 + c2 − (ab + bc + ca)]

Calculations:

⇒ (20)2 = 152 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ 400 = 152 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ 2(ab + bc + ca) = 400 − 152

⇒ 2(ab + bc + ca) = 248

⇒ (ab + bc + ca) = 248 ÷ 2 = 124

Now, substituting the values into the second identity:

⇒ a3 + b3 + c3 − 3abc = 20 × (152 − 124)

⇒ a3 + b3 + c3 − 3abc = 20 × 28

⇒ a3 + b3 + c3 − 3abc = 560

∴ The correct answer is 560.

Additional Information

Cubic Identity Condition

If a + b + c = 0, then the primary identity simplifies directly to a3 + b3 + c3 = 3abc.

Alternative Cubic Form

a3 + b3 + c3 − 3abc = 1/2 × (a + b + c)[(a − b)2 + (b − c)2 + (c − a)2]

Standard Binomial Cubes

(a + b)3 = a3 + b3 + 3ab(a + b) and (a − b)3 = a3 − b3 − 3ab(a − b)

questions.question: If the value of (a + b - 2) 2 + (b + c - 5) 2 + (c + a - 5) 2 = 0, then the value of \(\sqrt {{{\left( {b + c} \right)}^a} + {{\left( {c + a} \right)}^b} - 1} \) is:
questions.questionHtml: If the value of (a + b - 2)2 + (b + c - 5)2 + (c + a - 5)2 = 0, then the value of \(\sqrt {{{\left( {b + c} \right)}^a} + {{\left( {c + a} \right)}^b} - 1} \) is:
questions.solution:
As we know,

If (a - b)2 + (x - y)2 = 0, then a - b = 0 and x - y = 0,

(a + b - 2)2 + (b + c - 5)2 + (c + a - 5)2 = 0

So,

(a + b - 2) = 0

⇒ a + b = 2     ---- (1)

(b + c - 5) = 0

⇒ b + c = 5     ---- (2)

(c + a - 5) = 0

⇒ c + a = 5     ---- (3)

Solving, (1), (2) and (3), we get

a = 1, b = 1 and c = 4

Now, \(\sqrt {{{\left( {b + c} \right)}^a} + {{\left( {c + a} \right)}^b} - 1} = \sqrt {{{\left( {1 + 4} \right)}^1} + {{\left( {4 + 1} \right)}^1} - 1} = \sqrt 9 = 3\)

questions.question: If 3a - b = 1 and ab = 4, then the value of (9a 2 - b 2 ) is:
questions.questionHtml: If 3a - b = 1 and ab = 4, then the value of (9a<sup>2</sup> - b<sup>2</sup>) is:
questions.solution:
Given:

3a – b = 1 and ab = 4

Formula used:

(a – b)2 = a2 + b2 – 2ab 

Calculation:

3a – b = 1

squaring both sides

(3a)2 + (b)2 – 2 × 3a × b = (1)2

⇒ 9a2 + b2 – 6ab = 1

Adding 12ab both sides, we get

⇒ 9a2 + b2 – 6ab + 12ab = 1 + 12ab

⇒ 9a2 + b2 + 6ab = 1 + 12ab

⇒ (3a + b)2 = 1 + 12ab

⇒ (3a + b)2 = 1 + 12 × 4

⇒ (3a + b)2 = 1 + 48

⇒ (3a + b)2 = 49

⇒ (3a + b)2 = 72

⇒ (3a + b) = 7

Now,

(9a2 - b2) = (3a - b)(3a + b) = 1 × 7 = 7

∴ The required value is 7

questions.question: If x 2 - 8x + 1 = 0 , what is the value of x 8 - 3842x 4 + 1?
questions.questionHtml: If x<sup>2</sup> - 8x + 1 = 0 , what is the value of x<sup>8</sup> - 3842x<sup>4</sup> + 1?
questions.solution:
Given:

x2 - 8x + 1 = 0

Formula used:

(a + b)2 = a2 + b2 + 2ab

Calculations:

x2 - 8x + 1 = 0

⇒ x2 + 1 = 8x (dividing x on both sides)

⇒ x + 1/x = 8 (squaring both sides)

⇒ (x + 1/x)2 = 82 

⇒ x2 + 2 + 1/x2 = 64

⇒ x2 + 1/x2 = 62 (squaring both sides)

⇒ (x2)2 + (1/x2)2 = (62)2 

⇒ x4 + 2 + 1/x4 = 3844

⇒ x4 + 1/x4 = 3842

⇒ x8 + 1 = 3842x4 

⇒ x8 - 3842x4 + 1 = 0

∴ The value of given equation is 0.

Shortcut TrickIf \(x + \frac{1}{x} \) = a, then \(x^2 + \frac{1}{x^2}\) = a2 - 2

Here, we have x2 - 8x + 1 = 0

⇒ \(x + \frac{1}{x} \) = 8 

⇒ \(x^2 + \frac{1}{x^2}\) = 82  - 2 = 64 - 2 = 62

⇒ \(x^4 + \frac{1}{x^4}\) = (62)2 - 2 

⇒ \(x^4 + \frac{1}{x^4}\) = 3844 - 2 = 3842

⇒ x8 + 1 = 3842x4 

⇒ x8 - 3842x4 + 1 = 0

questions.question: If x + y + z = 18, xyz = 81 and xy + yz + zx = 90, then the value of x 3 + y 3 + z 3 + xyz is :

⇒ x3 + y3 + z3 - 3 × 81 = 18[(18)2 - 3 × 90] ⇒ x3 + y3 + z3 = 18 × 54 + 243 = 1215

Now, x3 + y3 + z3 + xyz = 1215 + 81 = 1296

questions.question: If x 2 - 5x + 1 = 0, then the value of \(\left(x^4 + \frac 1 {x^2}\right) \div \left(x^2 + 1\right)\) is:
questions.questionHtml: If x2 - 5x + 1 = 0, then the value of \(\left(x^4 + \frac 1 {x^2}\right) \div \left(x^2 + 1\right)\) is:
questions.solution:
Given:

x2 - 5x + 1 = 0

Formula used:

(a + b)3 = a3 + b3 + 3ab(a + b)

Calculations:

x2 - 5x + 1 = 0

⇒ x(x - 5 + 1/x) = 0

⇒ (x - 5 + 1/x) = 0

⇒ (x + 1/x) = 5

Taking cube both sides,

⇒ (x + 1/x)3 = (5)3

⇒ x3 + 1/x3 + 3(x)(1/x)(x + 1/x) = 125

⇒ x3 + 1/x3 + 3(5) = 125

⇒ x3 + 1/x3 + 15 = 125

⇒ x3 + 1/x3 = 125 - 15

⇒ x3 + 1/x3 = 110

(x4 + 1/x2)/(x2 + 1)

Dividing the numerator and denominator by x,

(1/x)(x4 + 1/x2)/(x2 + 1)(1/x)

⇒ (x3 + 1/x3)/(x + 1/x)

⇒ 110/5

⇒ 22

∴ The value of \(\left(x^4 + \frac 1 {x^2}\right) \div \left(x^2 + 1\right)\) is 22.

questions.question: If a 2 + b 2 + 49c 2 + 18 = 2(b + 28c - a), then the value of (2a - b + 7c) is:
questions.questionHtml: If a<sup>2</sup> + b<sup>2</sup> + 49c<sup>2</sup> + 18 = 2(b + 28c - a), then the value of (2a - b + 7c) is:
questions.solution:
⇒ a2 + b2 + 49c2 + 18 = 2(b + 28c - a)

⇒ a2 + b2  + 49c2 + 18 - 2b - 56c + 2a = 0

⇒ (a2 + 2a + 1 ) + (b2 - 2b + 1) + (7c)2 - 56c + 16 = 0

⇒ (a + 1)2 + (b - 1)2  + (7c - 4)2 = 0

Now, (a + 1)2 = 0 ⇒ a = -1, (b - 1)2 = 0 ⇒ b = 1 and (7c - 4)2 = 0 

⇒ c = \(4\over7 \) 

As per question, (2a - b + 7c) = (2 × -1) - 1 + 7 × \(4\over7 \) ⇒ 1

 Put x = 7, y = 1

 Alternate Method

questions.question: If \(x^4 + \frac{1}{x^4} = \frac{257}{16}\) then find \(\frac{8}{13} (x^3 + \frac{1}{x^3})\) , where x > 0.
questions.questionHtml: If \(x^4 + \frac{1}{x^4} = \frac{257}{16}\) then find \(\frac{8}{13} (x^3 + \frac{1}{x^3})\), where x > 0.
questions.solution:
Given:

\(x^4 + \frac{1}{x^4} = \frac{257}{16}\)

Formula:

(x + 1/x)2 = x2 + 1/x2 + 2

(x3 + 1/x3) = (x + 1/x)3 – 3 (x + 1/x)

Calculation:

(x2 + 1/x2)2 = x4 + 1/x4 + 2

⇒ (x2 + 1/x2)2 = (257/16) + 2

⇒ (x2 + 1/x2)2 = (257 + 32)/16

⇒ (x2 + 1/x2) = √(289/16)

⇒ (x2 + 1/x2) = 17/4

Again,

(x + 1/x)2 = x2 + 1/x2 + 2

⇒ (x + 1/x)2 = (17/4) + 2

⇒ (x + 1/x)2 = (17 + 8)/4

⇒ (x + 1/x) = √(25/4)

⇒ (x + 1/x) = 5/2

(x3 + 1/x3) = (x + 1/x)3 – 3 (x + 1/x)

⇒ (x3 + 1/x3) = (5/2)3 – 3 × (5/2)

⇒ (x3 + 1/x3) = (125/8) – (15/2)

⇒ (x3 + 1/x3) = (125 – 60)/8

⇒ (x3 + 1/x3) = 65/8

⇒ (8/13) × (x3 + 1/x3) = (65/8) × (8/13)

⇒ (8/13) × (x3 + 1/x3) = 5

∴ The required value is 5.

Shortcut TrickIf \(x^2 + \frac{1}{x^2}\) = a , then \(x + \frac{1}{x}\) = √(a + 2)

So,  if \((x^2)^2 + \frac{1}{(x^2)^2}\) = 257/16, then \(x^2 + \frac{1}{x^2}\) = \(\sqrt{\frac{257}{16} + 2}~\) = 17/4

Again, \(x^2 + \frac{1}{x^2}\) = 17/4, then \(x + \frac{1}{x}\) = \(\sqrt{\frac{17}{4}+ 2}~\) = 5/2

Now, (x3 + 1/x3) = (x + 1/x)3 – 3(x + 1/x)

⇒ (5/2)3 – 3 × (5/2) = 65/8

∴  (8/13) × (x3 + 1/x3) = (65/8) × (8/13) = 5

questions.questionHtml: If a + b – c = 7, ab – bc – ca = 21, then a<sup>3</sup> + b<sup>3</sup> – c<sup>3</sup> + 3abc =

a + b – c = 7, ab – bc – ca = 21

Calculation∶

Put c = – c into above identity,

⇒ a3 + b3 + ( – c)3 – 3ab( – c) = {a + b + ( – c)}{a2 + b2 + ( – c)2 – ab – b( – c) – ( – c)a}

⇒ a3 + b3 – c3 + 3abc = (a + b – c)(a2 + b2 + c2 – ab + bc + ca)

⇒ a3 + b3 – c3 + 3abc = (a + b – c)(a2 + b2 + c2 – ab + bc + ca + 2ab + 2bc + 2ca – 2ab – 2bc – 2ca)

⇒ a3 + b3 – c3 + 3abc = (a + b – c)(a2 + b2 + c2 + 2ab – 2bc – 2ca – 3ab + 3bc + 3ca)

Using equation (1),

⇒ a3 + b3 – c3 + 3abc = (a + b – c){(a + b – c)2 – 3ab + 3bc + 3ca}

questions.question: If (a + b) = √11 and (a - b) = √7, then find the value of a 2 b 2 (a 2 + b 2 ).
questions.questionHtml: If (a + b) = √11 and (a - b) = √7, then find the value of a<sup>2</sup> b<sup>2</sup> (a<sup>2</sup> + b<sup>2</sup>).
questions.solution:
Given:

(a + b) = √11

(a - b) = √7

Formula Used:

(a + b)2 = a2 + b2 + 2ab

Calculations:

⇒ (a + b) = √11

Squaring both sides,

⇒ (a + b)2 = (√11)2

⇒ a2 + b2 + 2ab = 11 ........ (1)

Similarly,

⇒ (a - b)2 = (√7)2

⇒ a2 + b2 - 2ab = 7 ........ (2)

Now, Subtract eq(2) from (1)

⇒ a2 + b2 + 2ab - (a2 + b2 - 2ab) = 11 - 7

⇒ a2 + b2 + 2ab - a2 - b2 + 2ab = 4

⇒ 4ab = 4

⇒ ab = 1

From the formula,

⇒ (a + b)2 = a2 + b2 + 2ab

⇒ a2 + b2 = (a + b)2 - 2ab = (√11)2 - 2 x 1 = 11 - 2 = 9

According to the question,

⇒ a2 b2 (a2 + b2) = (1)2 x 9 = 1 x 9 = 9

Hence, The value of the above equation is 9

questions.question: If 2x 2 - 6x = 1, then \(x^2 + \frac{1}{4x^2}=?\)
questions.questionHtml: If 2x2 - 6x = 1, then \(x^2 + \frac{1}{4x^2}=?\)
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Divide the given equation 2x2 − 6x = 1 by 2x to normalize the x term.

We get: x − 3 = 1/(2x) ⇒ x − 1/(2x) = 3.

Apply the square logic: (a − b)2 = a2 + b2 − 2ab.

Result = 32 + 2 × (x) × (1/2x) = 9 + 1 = 10.

∴ The correct answer is 10.

Alternate Method

Given: 2x2 − 6x = 1

Formula Used: (a − b)2 = a2 + b2 − 2ab

Step-by-step Calculation:

⇒ 2x2 − 6x = 1

⇒ 2x2 − 1 = 6x

⇒ Dividing both sides by 2x:

⇒ (2x2 / 2x) − (1 / 2x) = (6x / 2x)

⇒ x − 1/(2x) = 3

⇒ Now, squaring both sides:

⇒ (x − 1/(2x))2 = 32

⇒ x2 + (1/2x)2 − 2 × x × (1/2x) = 9

⇒ x2 + 1/(4x2) − 1 = 9

⇒ x2 + 1/(4x2) = 9 + 1

⇒ x2 + 1/(4x2) = 10

∴ The correct answer is 10.

Additional Information

Algebraic Identity for Squares

(a − b)2 = a2 + b2 − 2ab and (a + b)2 = a2 + b2 + 2ab.

Reciprocal Identity Shortcut

If x − 1/x = k, then x2 + 1/x2 = k2 + 2. If the coefficients are different, like ax − 1/bx = k, then a2x2 + 1/b2x2 = k2 + 2(a/b).

Cubic Expansion

If x − 1/x = k, then x3 − 1/x3 = k3 + 3k.

questions.question: If x + y = \(\frac{5}{6}\) and \(\frac{1}{x}\) + \(\frac{1}{y}\) = 7 \(\frac{1}{2}\) , then what is the value of x 3 + y 3 ?

Concept Used:

We get, (x + y)/xy = 15/2

xy = 2(x + y)/15      ----(1)

Now, solving (x + y) = 5/6

cubing both sides

x3 + y3 + 3xy(x + y) = 125/216

⇒ x3 + y3 + [3 x 2(x + y)/15] (x + y) = 125/216

⇒ x3 + y3 + (2/5)(x + y)2 = 125/216

⇒ x3 + y3 + (2/5) (25/36) = 125/216

⇒ x3 + y3 + 50/180 = 125/216

⇒ x3 + y3 = 125/216 - 50/180

⇒ x3 + y3 = 65/216

Therefore, the value of x3 + y3 is 65/216

questions.question: If x 2 + 9y 2 + 4z 2 = 12(x - 2y + 2z) - 88, then the value of (x - 3y + z) is:
questions.questionHtml: If x<sup>2</sup> + 9y<sup>2</sup> + 4z<sup>2</sup> = 12(x - 2y + 2z) - 88, then the value of (x - 3y + z) is:

Given:

x2 + 9y2 + 4z2 = 12(x - 2y + 2z) - 88

Formula used:

(a + b)2 = a2 + b2 + 2ab

Calculation:

⇒ x2 + 9y2 + 4z2 = 12x - 24y + 24z - 88

⇒ x2 + 9y2 + 4z2 - 12x + 24y - 24z + 88 = 0

⇒ x2 - 12x + 36 + 9y2 + 24y + 16 + 4z2 - 24z + 36 = 0

⇒ (x - 6)2 + (3y + 4)2 + (2z - 6)2 = 0

(x - 6) = 0

⇒ x = 6

(3y + 4) = 0

⇒ y = - 4/3

(2z - 6) = 0

⇒ z = 3

(x - 3y + z)

⇒ 6 + 4 + 3 

⇒ 13

∴ Required answer is 13

questions.question: If \(x - \frac{1}{x}= \sqrt{77}\) , then one of the values of \(x^3+\frac{1}{x^3}\) is:
questions.questionHtml: If \(x - \frac{1}{x}= \sqrt{77}\), then one of the values of \(x^3+\frac{1}{x^3}\) is:
questions.solution:

\(x - \frac{1}{x}= √{77}\)

Formula used:

(x + 1/x)2 = (x)2 + (1/x)2 + 2 × x × 1/x

Calculation:

Squaring both sides, we get

(x – 1/x)2 = (√77)2

⇒ (x)2 + (1/x)2 – 2 × x × 1/x = 77

⇒ x2 + 1/x2 – 2 = 77

⇒ x2 + 1/x2 = (77 + 2)

⇒ x2 + 1/x2 = 79

Now,

(x + 1/x)2 = x2 + 1/x2 + 2 × x × 1/x

⇒ x2 + 1/x2 + 2 

⇒ 79 + 2

⇒ 81

⇒ (x + 1/x) = 9

Now,

(x3 + 1/x3) = (x + 1/x)3 – 3 × x × 1/x × (x + 1/x)

⇒ (9)3 – 3 × 9

⇒ 729 – 27

⇒ 702

We know that when we find a square root of any number there is a two value coming i.e. positive value or negative value

So,

⇒ 702 is not given, it means the right value of the given question is -702

∴ The required value is -702

Now,

⇒ - 93 - 3(- 9)

⇒ -729 + 27

⇒ - 702

∴ The required value is -702

questions.question: If x 2 + y 2 + 2y + 4x + 5 = 0, then \(\frac{x+y}{x-y}=\) ________.
questions.questionHtml: If x2 + y2 + 2y + 4x + 5 = 0, then \(\frac{x+y}{x-y}=\) ________.

x2 + y2 + 2y + 4x + 5 = 0

⇒ x2 + y2 + 2y + 4x + 4 + 1 = 0 ⇒ x2 +  4x + 4 + y2 + 2y + 1 = 0 ⇒ (x + 2)2 + (y + 1)2 = 0

questions.question: Simplify the given expression. \(\frac{a^2-b^2-2 b c-c^2}{a^2+b^2+2 a b-c^2}\)
questions.questionHtml:
Simplify the given expression.

\(\frac{a^2-b^2-2 b c-c^2}{a^2+b^2+2 a b-c^2}\)
questions.solution:
\(\frac{a^2-b^2-2 b c-c^2}{a^2+b^2+2 a b-c^2}\) = \(​​​​\frac{a^2-( b^2 + c^2 + 2bc)}{( a^2 + b^2 + 2bc) - c^2}\)

⇒\(\frac{a^2 - (b + c)^2}{( a + b )^2 - c^2}\) = \(\frac{(a-b-c)(a+b+c)}{(a+b+c)(a+b-c)}\) ⇒ \(\frac{a-b-c}{a+b-c} \)
